description: Investigation roles to verify. These are not ten named or ranked defendants, and not ten accusations.

roles.title: Board chair / top executive
roles.question: Identify board and chief executive decision authority, mandates and tenure
roles.public_evidence: Governance charters, corporate annual reports and board minutes when public
roles.legal_note: Function or title alone does not establish personal liability, wrongful conduct, pollution causation or jurisdiction.

roles.title: Chief executive or chief operating executive
roles.question: Confirm who directly approved or delegated material operating decisions
roles.public_evidence: Annual reports, public delegated-authority policies, executive announcements
roles.legal_note: Function or title alone does not establish personal liability, wrongful conduct, pollution causation or jurisdiction.

roles.title: Finance and compensation
roles.question: Identify capital-allocation and published compensation relationships; benefits are not illicit gains
roles.public_evidence: Annual proxy remuneration, financial statements, authorized benefits
roles.legal_note: Function or title alone does not establish personal liability, wrongful conduct, pollution causation or jurisdiction.

roles.title: Global/segment operations
roles.question: Establish site and process operational authority only through dated records
roles.public_evidence: Facility/operator permits, governance disclosures, signed operational records
roles.legal_note: Function or title alone does not establish personal liability, wrongful conduct, pollution causation or jurisdiction.

roles.title: Environmental, health and safety function
roles.question: Verify who had responsibility for compliance processes and affected facilities
roles.public_evidence: EHS organization charts, permits, official inspections, documented decisions
roles.legal_note: Function or title alone does not establish personal liability, wrongful conduct, pollution causation or jurisdiction.

roles.title: Legal and regulatory compliance
roles.question: Document compliance oversight responsibility without assuming knowledge or misconduct
roles.public_evidence: Public filings, disclosed policies, regulator correspondence
roles.legal_note: Function or title alone does not establish personal liability, wrongful conduct, pollution causation or jurisdiction.

roles.title: Specific facility operational lead
roles.question: Find a named regulated facility and direct operator during a documented release period
roles.public_evidence: Dated facility permit, regulator site record, sworn evidence if public
roles.legal_note: Function or title alone does not establish personal liability, wrongful conduct, pollution causation or jurisdiction.

roles.title: Strategy, technical or capital deployment
roles.question: Investigate documented project or disposal approvals with precise time periods
roles.public_evidence: Board resolutions when public, project approvals, engineering disclosures
roles.legal_note: Function or title alone does not establish personal liability, wrongful conduct, pollution causation or jurisdiction.

roles.title: Board risk / audit / sustainability oversight
roles.question: Establish committee mandates, effective terms and what information was actually received
roles.public_evidence: Proxy committee charters, annual board biographies, public board papers
roles.legal_note: Function or title alone does not establish personal liability, wrongful conduct, pollution causation or jurisdiction.

roles.title: Historical predecessor / relevant period
roles.question: Avoid excluding people whose authority coincided with a verified historical incident
roles.public_evidence: Prior-year annual reports, archived officers, historical filings
roles.legal_note: Function or title alone does not establish personal liability, wrongful conduct, pollution causation or jurisdiction.
